_source: Built from DeepSeek's Search API reference (https://api-docs.deepseek.com/api/search/) and Search & Fetch guide (https://api-docs.deepseek.com/guides/search/). The success body is the reference's populated example result, followed by a second result with a null date and an empty summary, built from the same schema. The empty body is the documented no-match reply (an empty results array); the malformed body drops results. Error bodies use the documented OpenAI-compatible error object (message, type, param null, code); the guide publishes one such example (the 400 one here), so the messages and types of the other statuses are illustrative. No Retry-After header is documented.
